pkgmetadata.longdescription: Anthropic's official Claude desktop app for Linux, repackaged from the .deb they publish for Debian/Ubuntu. Provides the Chat, Cowork and Claude Code tabs. Cowork executes its local agent inside a KVM microVM driven by qemu-system-x86_64, virtiofsd and OVMF firmware.

use.flag: Pull in libayatana-appindicator for the StatusNotifier tray icon
Pull in the KVM/QEMU stack (qemu, virtiofsd, OVMF firmware) required by the Cowork agent, and install the /usr/share/OVMF compatibility symlinks it probes
